name: Ferryx mobile active-terminal mirror via Web delegation

definition.name: Ferryx mobile active-terminal mirror via Web delegation

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Dispatch exactly ONE bounded ChatGPT Web helper batch that implements the three disjoint Ferryx mobile active-terminal mirror lanes below.
DELIVERABLE: Immediately forward every helper --progress-json NDJSON record, including each event:"dispatched" and event:"terminal", to the DAG progress log; then return the helper JSON result with every retained scope_id, ready state, terminal state, changed files, RED-to-GREEN tests, and any authoritative error.
SCOPE: Read .omo/notepads/mobile-active-terminal-mirror-20260823.md and current source. Do not edit repository files, manipulate git state, create commits, start desktop apps, or close scopes. Locate the installed target/release/delegate_to_chatgpt_web helper. Invoke it exactly once with --batch-stdin --json --progress-json; leave browser-driver selection unset. Do not start a second fresh helper and do not replace Web work with local coding. If the helper is missing, returns capacity exhaustion, rate-limit cooldown, or an authoritative terminal error, report that fact unchanged and stop.
VERIFY: The single helper batch contains exactly these three disjoint tasks. Every returned Web worker is ready before dispatch and each has a terminal record.

WEB TASK 1 — Native active desktop context contract
Implement safe typed native Remote support for one desktop-focused terminal plus authenticated workspace/worktree selection. Write only src-tauri/src/remote/**, src-tauri/src/ipc/remote.rs, src-tauri/src/lib.rs, and direct native tests. The state/API must keep a safe active desktop context (no paths), expose at most its focused PTY through workspace state/sessions, deny WebSocket attach to every other live PTY, enumerate safe registered workspace/worktree identities, and accept a validated mobile selection request that reaches a desktop bridge. Preserve pairing/permissions. Work test-first: prove background PTYs are excluded, inactive attach is rejected, and selection validates identity/publishes no paths. Run focused Cargo tests and rustfmt. Do not write ui/**, docs/**, .omo/**, manifests, or git state.

WEB TASK 2 — Desktop focused-context publisher
Implement desktop synchronization of live layout focus with that native Remote context, and apply a mobile workspace/worktree selection with existing App/store actions. Write only ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, and their direct tests. Derive the active tab's focused leaf -> local session -> backend session ID; publish updates after project/worktree/tab/pane focus changes; browser focus must clear the Remote active terminal. Receive the native selection bridge and select the requested project/worktree using existing behavior. Work test-first and run focused Vitest/TypeScript checks. Do not write ui/src/remote/**, src-tauri/**, docs/**, .omo/**, manifests, or git state.

WEB TASK 3 — Mobile one-terminal mirror and selector UX
Replace the Remote multi-session mobile list with one server-declared active desktop terminal plus a desktop-quality workspace/worktree selector that uses the safe selection API. Write only ui/src/remote/** and its direct tests. Show current workspace/worktree breadcrumb, exactly the declared terminal, selector/drawer rows, active selection, a pending state after request, a useful no-focused-terminal state, touch targets, and no absolute paths. A response that contains background sessions must never render or attach them. Work test-first and run cd ui && npx vitest run src/remote --maxWorkers=1. Do not write ui/src/App.tsx, ui/src/lib/tauri.ts, src-tauri/**, docs/**, .omo/**, manifests, or git state.

STOP WHEN: Report helper JSON result or the first authoritative helper/environment error.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Perform a read-only final verification of the joined Ferryx active-terminal mobile mirror work after the retained Web batch finishes.
DELIVERABLE: Exact commands, exit codes, relevant test output, and a requirement-to-evidence mapping; report the first concrete failure if any.
SCOPE: Read source and outputs only. Do not edit source/tests, create commits, change git state, invoke ChatGPT Web, start/close Web scopes, or operate desktop UI.
VERIFY: Require exit 0 for targeted Rust tests covering active Remote context, active-only state/list, rejected inactive websocket attach, and workspace selection bridge; cd ui && npx vitest run src/remote src/App.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1; cd ui && npm run build; cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml; and LSP diagnostics for changed UI/native paths. Inspect code to prove only the focused desktop backend session is visible/attachable, workspace selection uses safe identities rather than paths, the mobile selector has pending and confirmed state, and no raw absolute path renders.
STOP WHEN: Return PASS only with all gates green and every behavior evidenced; otherwise return the first concrete failure.
